{{Top|leg}}
The '''LD-8 exterminator droid''' was a type of hovering pesticide [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was used to spray fields to rid them of infestations of [[Jevesect]]s, a type of crop-destroying [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]]. The LD-8 wasn't a very advanced design, but it was the cheapest pesticide droid available, so was the model in most widespread use.
